channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: The world urgently needs a US-Iran deal now
item.description: Without a deal between Washington and Tehran, the fallout from Strait of Hormuz closure could deepen global crises.

item.title: Trump’s war loop: Escalate, retreat, repeat
item.description: Stuck in a quagmire of a war, Trump chafes at negative coverage while Iran digs its heels in.

item.title: Iran war day 87: Trump says US not in rush to sign deal, dashing optimism
item.description: Iranian media are reporting that a deal may not be reached amid disagreements on some key issues.

item.title: Trump says any deal with Iran will be ‘great and meaningful’
item.description: US president says that an agreement with Iran would be "great and meaningful" or there would be "no deal".

item.title: Singapore’s economy beats expectations as gov’t warns of Iran war fallout
item.description: GDP grows 6 percent year-on-year in first quarter as AI boom outweighs rising energy costs.

item.title: Deal with US not imminent, Iran says
item.description: The US secretary of state earlier said that an agreement could possibly come on Monday.

item.title: Oil prices slide on hopes of US-Iran peace deal
item.description: Trump said on Saturday that an agreement would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, without giving further details.

item.title: Man killed in shark attack off Australia's north-east coast
item.description: The 39-year-old was fatally injured at a shoal off the Cassowary Coast in Queensland, apparently while spearfishing.

item.title: Suspect killed after opening fire on Secret Service near White House
item.description: Officials say a suspect approached a checkpoint near the building and opened fire, and that a bystander was wounded.

item.title: One killed and many feared trapped under collapsed building in Philippines
item.description: A Malaysian man has died and about 20 people are feared trapped at the site near Manila, officials say.
